Homogenize x only with X0, padding products to d, and add dummy variables to n. Over E(z) the numerator is homogeneous degree d in X. Apply Saxena-Seshadhri STOC2011 Theorem2/Lemma11 r=6 maps X_i->sum_(j=1)^6 beta^(ij)Y_j, fixing z. Complete restricted quotients Q_beta=G_beta/B^k in E[z,Y1..Y6] distinguish every pair of this class, since numerator differences have at most6 products and all36dn+1 maps detect nonzero. Each has z-degree<=d-2k, homogeneous Y-degree d, support <=(d-2k+1)binom(d+5,5). Restricted factor lists have <=12 monomials per factor, so ordinary polynomial-table operations construct full coefficient data in polynomial field operations; no unrestricted coefficient oracle. Each of a binary coefficient components has sum-of-monomials depth<=2, total per-seed sizeO(a(d+1)^7) counting ordinary repeated variable wires; all data sizeO(na(d+1)^8),a=O(log(dn+1)).
